fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on Miami public safety and law enforcement, including discussion of City Safety Director Andrew J. Kavanaugh and a traffic-safety campaign emphasizing enforcement against drunken and reckless driving. Reports and opinion pieces address alleged fraud connected to a home-building/savings-and-loan scheme involving the Federal Savings & Loan Association of Miami and the J. M. Lipton Insurance Agency, and anticipate a federal grand jury inquiry into bankruptcy and receivership practices. Additional coverage includes municipal politics and rumors at city hall, telephone rate reductions and ongoing advocacy, results of Miami Life’s “Most Attractive Working Girl” contest, and entertainment/sports items such as Florida racing dates and wrestling promotion at the Coral Gables Coliseum, alongside society columns and local advertisements.
